description: Build an unsigned deposit transaction into an Arcadia lending tranche (ERC-4626). Lenders deposit the pool's underlying asset (USDC/WETH/cbBTC) and receive tranche shares that accrue interest from borrowers. Requires prior ERC-20 approval to the tranche (see write_wallet_approve). To check current lender yield, call read_pool_list or read_pool_info.

assets.description: Amount of underlying asset to deposit, in raw units (e.g. '1000000' = 1 USDC since USDC has 6 decimals).

receiver.description: Address that receives the minted tranche shares. Usually the depositor's own wallet.

tranche_address.description: Tranche contract address (ERC-4626 vault). Get this from read_pool_list: each pool's `tranches[0].address`.

name: write_pool_deposit
